cases.why: One-word query; substring match finds exactly the settling decision.

decisions.title: Cursor pagination for list endpoints
decisions.decision: Offset/limit removed in v2; cursor = base64(created_at,id).
decisions.rationale: Offsets degrade on large tenants and skip rows under concurrent inserts.

decisions.title: Amounts stored as i64 minor units
decisions.decision: Every amount is i64 minor units plus ISO 4217 currency; no floats or decimal strings in the DB or API.
decisions.rationale: Float rounding caused 1-cent reconciliation drift against Stripe.

decisions.title: Rate limiting stays in-process
decisions.decision: GCRA in Redis called from RateLimitLayer; not moved to Envoy global rate limit.
decisions.rationale: Per-tenant plan limits live in Postgres; syncing them to Envoy adds a moving part.

decisions.title: Limiter fails open
decisions.decision: On Redis errors or 50ms timeout the request is allowed.
decisions.rationale: Availability over strictness; abuse window bounded by rl_fail_open_total alerting.

decisions.title: pgbouncer transaction pooling
decisions.decision: All app traffic goes through pgbouncer in transaction mode; sqlx statement cache disabled.
decisions.rationale: 40 pods x 20 connections exceeds Postgres max_connections.

decisions.title: Row-level security for tenant isolation
decisions.decision: Every tenant table has an RLS policy on app.tenant_id, set with SET LOCAL per transaction.
decisions.rationale: Defense in depth after INC-212.

decisions.title: Credential hashing parameters
decisions.decision: argon2id m=19MiB t=2 p=1 for passwords and API key secrets; verification runs in spawn_blocking.
decisions.rationale: OWASP baseline; keeps verification under 50ms on 4 vCPU pods.

decisions.title: Token lifetimes
decisions.decision: JWT access tokens expire after 15 min; refresh tokens 30 days, rotated on each use with reuse detection.
decisions.rationale: Short access tokens limit blast radius; rotation detects stolen refresh tokens.

decisions.title: Error format
decisions.decision: All error responses use RFC 7807 problem+json with stable type URIs.
decisions.rationale: SDKs switch on type; titles may change.

decisions.title: Invoices are never hard deleted
decisions.decision: Invoices get deleted_at (soft delete); rows are kept.
decisions.rationale: German retention law requires 10 years; auditors need the full sequence of invoice numbers.

decisions.title: Jobs on apalis + Redis
decisions.decision: Background jobs use apalis with the existing Redis; no dedicated broker such as RabbitMQ or SQS.
decisions.rationale: Volume is under 50 jobs/s; one fewer piece of infrastructure to run.

decisions.title: Outbound webhook signing
decisions.decision: HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp.body; during secret rotation sign with both secrets for 24h.
decisions.rationale: Customers cannot switch secrets atomically.

decisions.title: Stripe Tax replaces in-house tax tables
decisions.decision: New tax calculation goes through Stripe Tax behind flag tax_v2; legacy tax_rates kept until EU rollout.
decisions.rationale: Maintaining VAT rates by hand caused two misfiled returns.

decisions.title: Timestamps and billing periods
decisions.decision: Store UTC; compute billing period boundaries in the tenant timezone.
decisions.rationale: Customers expect invoices to follow their local calendar month.

decisions.title: Probe semantics
decisions.decision: Liveness checks only the process; readiness checks Postgres and Redis.
decisions.rationale: A dependency outage must remove pods from load balancing, not restart them all.

decisions.title: Telemetry via OTLP only
decisions.decision: Traces and metrics exported with OTLP to the collector; no vendor SDKs linked into the app.
decisions.rationale: Switching vendors is a collector config change.

decisions.title: Feature flags stay in-house
decisions.decision: Flags live in the tenant_flags table, cached per request; we do not adopt LaunchDarkly or another hosted flag service.
decisions.rationale: Cost at our tenant count and no need for percentage rollouts yet.

decisions.title: Secrets at boot
decisions.decision: Secrets are read from AWS Secrets Manager at startup; rotation is applied by a rolling restart.
decisions.rationale: No hot-reload code paths to test.

decisions.title: Replica usage
decisions.decision: Only GET list endpoints read from the replica; writes and read-after-write go to the primary.
decisions.rationale: Replica lag of up to 2s is acceptable for lists, not for detail views after edits.

decisions.title: Integration tests hit real Postgres
decisions.decision: tests/ run against a real Postgres (testcontainers locally, service container in CI) with a unique tenant per test; no in-memory repository fakes.
decisions.rationale: Fakes hid RLS policy bugs twice.

decisions.title: Stripe mocked with wiremock
decisions.decision: Tests stub Stripe with wiremock; no live Stripe test-mode keys in CI.
decisions.rationale: Test-mode API is rate limited and flaky from CI.

decisions.title: Data fixes go through ledgerctl
decisions.decision: Production data changes are made with reviewed ledgerctl subcommands; no ad-hoc SQL sessions against prod.
decisions.rationale: Every change is logged and reproducible; INC-219 came from a hand-typed statement.

decisions.title: Which responses are metered
decisions.decision: Only 2xx responses count toward the monthly plan quota.
decisions.rationale: Customers were charged for throttled and failed calls (BILL-88).

decisions.title: Middleware order
decisions.decision: Outer to inner: CorsLayer, RequestIdLayer, AuthLayer, RateLimitLayer, MeteringLayer.
decisions.rationale: Preflight must not need auth; the limiter needs TenantId from auth.

decisions.title: Public router
decisions.decision: Unauthenticated endpoints (status, pricing) live on public_router(), limited per client IP.
decisions.rationale: Keeps tenant middleware out of anonymous paths.

decisions.title: Single HTTP client
decisions.decision: reqwest is the only outbound HTTP client, built in http_client/mod.rs with pool_idle_timeout 90s.
decisions.rationale: One place for timeouts, proxies and request-id propagation.

decisions.title: API versioning
decisions.decision: Versions are URL prefixes (/v1, /v2); no Accept-header versioning.
decisions.rationale: Easier to route and cache; SDKs already hardcode prefixes.

decisions.title: Toolchain
decisions.decision: Rust edition 2024 on stable; MSRV is latest stable minus two releases.
decisions.rationale: Lets distro packagers build without nightly.

decisions.title: Upload path
decisions.decision: Clients upload with presigned S3 PUT, max 100 MB; the API never proxies file bytes.
decisions.rationale: Keeps API pods small and avoids request body limits.

decisions.title: Cursor pagination for list endpoints

decisions.title: Rate limiting stays in-process

decisions.title: pgbouncer transaction pooling
decisions.decision: All app traffic goes through pgbouncer in transaction mode; sqlx statement cache disabled.
decisions.rationale: 40 pods x 20 connections exceeds Postgres max_connections.

decisions.title: Row-level security for tenant isolation
decisions.decision: Every tenant table has an RLS policy on app.tenant_id, set with SET LOCAL per transaction.
decisions.rationale: Defense in depth after INC-212.

decisions.title: Credential hashing parameters
decisions.decision: argon2id m=19MiB t=2 p=1 for passwords and API key secrets; verification runs in spawn_blocking.
decisions.rationale: OWASP baseline; keeps verification under 50ms on 4 vCPU pods.

decisions.title: Token lifetimes
decisions.decision: JWT access tokens expire after 15 min; refresh tokens 30 days, rotated on each use with reuse detection.
decisions.rationale: Short access tokens limit blast radius; rotation detects stolen refresh tokens.

decisions.title: Error format
decisions.decision: All error responses use RFC 7807 problem+json with stable type URIs.
decisions.rationale: SDKs switch on type; titles may change.

decisions.title: Invoices are never hard deleted
decisions.decision: Invoices get deleted_at (soft delete); rows are kept.

decisions.title: Jobs on apalis + Redis
decisions.decision: Background jobs use apalis with the existing Redis; no dedicated broker such as RabbitMQ or SQS.
decisions.rationale: Volume is under 50 jobs/s; one fewer piece of infrastructure to run.

decisions.title: Outbound webhook retry policy
decisions.decision: Exponential backoff with jitter up to 24h, then the delivery moves to the dead-letter table.
decisions.rationale: Matches what customers expect from Stripe-style webhooks.

decisions.title: Outbound webhook signing
decisions.decision: HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp.body; during secret rotation sign with both secrets for 24h.
decisions.rationale: Customers cannot switch secrets atomically.

decisions.title: Stripe Tax replaces in-house tax tables
decisions.decision: New tax calculation goes through Stripe Tax behind flag tax_v2; legacy tax_rates kept until EU rollout.
decisions.rationale: Maintaining VAT rates by hand caused two misfiled returns.

decisions.title: Timestamps and billing periods
decisions.decision: Store UTC; compute billing period boundaries in the tenant timezone.
decisions.rationale: Customers expect invoices to follow their local calendar month.

decisions.title: Probe semantics
decisions.decision: Liveness checks only the process; readiness checks Postgres and Redis.
decisions.rationale: A dependency outage must remove pods from load balancing, not restart them all.

decisions.decision: Traces and metrics exported with OTLP to the collector; no vendor SDKs linked into the app.

decisions.rationale: Cost at our tenant count and no need for percentage rollouts yet.
